doc.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998

title: Playing around Westchester in the Swing Era
summary: He played dances and clubs around Westchester, keeping an open mind to all music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: father and my mother, and I just picked it up and blew it with the radio, and played with groups around town. Westchester was very big with music, very big. Every place you turned there was music going on.
It was the Swing Era, right?
And you played mostly for dances?

Played for everything. Dances, clubs and anything you can think of, I never closed my mind, I always had an open mind, which is why I can play the way I play. The more you sink into your mind the more it comes out.
